TileStructure.Forest.rowDecomp.issue: Definition body is shown (the n-row whose forest has 𝔘 = t.rowDecomp_𝔘 j and the same 𝔗 as t), but the English only gives the type and paraphrases the docstring; it does not describe the object by what it defines.

TileStructure.Forest.indicator_row_bound.issue: Lean hypothesis is Function.support g ⊆ G (the set where g ≠ 0), but the English writes 'supp g ⊆ G', which in standard notation (and next to 'compactly supported') denotes the closed support, a stronger hypothesis. Also 'bounded, measurable' is only an approximation of BoundedCompactSupport (MemLp g ∞, i.e. a.e.-strongly measurable and essentially bounded, plus compact support).

TileStructure.Forest.row_correlation.issue: Lean hypotheses are Function.support f₁ ⊆ G and Function.support f₂ ⊆ G (sets where f_i ≠ 0), but the English writes 'supp f_i ⊆ G', which standardly denotes the closed support (a stronger hypothesis), especially alongside 'compactly supported'.
